newsitem.title: UK: Internet advertising seen growing rapidly--report.
newsitem.headline: Internet advertising seen growing rapidly--report.

text.p: Internet advertising is expected to grow rapidly over the next five years as advertisers take advantage of more sophisticated measurement methods to target specific users, according to a report published on Tuesday by Zenith Media.

As advertisers and media owners get to grips with the medium over the next five years, enhanced audience measurement and tracking standards will develop, Zenith, the UK media planning and buying unit of Cordiant Plc , said in its report "Digital Media".

As a result, targeting software will improve significantly, with more companies using "push" technology. That will allow customised news and other targeted information to be automatically "pushed", or delivered, via the Internet to their users PCs.
But the Internet will complement rather than supplement other advertising media, Zenith said.
Internet commerce is expected to grow significantly, particularly impacting the travel, retail, finance, classified advertising and computer sectors, Zenith said.

In addition to the Internet, digital television is the other major emerging digital medium. Digital TV users are expected to to order video-on-demand movies, request pay-per-view events and provide home banking and shopping via TV sets equipped with modems. Zenith, however, said digital TV is not expected to be an instant success.
Zenith said it sees advertisers gradually developing on-demand content for interactive television, including on-screen ordering and loyalty schemes.
